Switching workspace changes the data lists. Repeated bad passwords lock the account. |

## Feature flags and hidden features
- **Admin-only screens:**
  - everything under `/admin/*`;
  - Settings writes;
  - `/settings/cleanup`;
  - vault `rotate-key` and `generate-key`.
- **Feature switches in Settings and env:**
  - `PROCESS_COVERAGE_BLOCKING` (defaults to True despite its comment);
  - the per-role model routes (`ROUTE_<ROLE>_MODEL`, `_EFFORT`, `_TIMEOUT_MS`, `_FALLBACK`);
  - Tool Service generation settings.
- **Build arguments:**
  - `WITH_MISTRAL_WORKFLOWS` in the backend image. Without it, the workflow routers fail to import and are skipped with a logged exception;
  - `WITH_BREV_CLI`, for Brev provisioning.
- **Neo4j-dependent features** (graph RAG, unified graph, taxonomy mirror) switch themselves off when Neo4j is unreachable.
- **Debug and diagnostic endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/status`;
  - `GET /health`, which includes whether the Tool Service is reachable;
  - the Tool Service `/metrics`, `/models` and `/secrets/status`;
  - the Swagger UIs at `/docs` on ports 8000 and 9000.
- **Developer scripts** in `backend/*.py` and `backend/scripts/` are not exposed in the UI.
